Instrument: City of Lakeway Code of Ordinances, Ch. 30 Zoning, Art. 30.03 'Zoning Use Regulations' (Â§ 30.03.001 â€“ Â§ 30.03.023), one base district per numbered section. Citation: https://ecode360.com/39617034. ROUTE: this article page DOES render its full section text and flattened setback blocks to a plain fetch, verified 2026-09-16 â€” no print endpoint or browser render was needed here, unlike Jonestown. The blocks are flattened tables ('Street(s):' / '25' on separate lines), so each quote renders the block as its label/value sequence with the cell text unaltered. VINTAGE read at source before extracting: the section amendment lines name Ordinance 2026-06-15-02 adopted 6/15/2026 (on Â§ 30.03.009 and Â§ 30.03.010) and 2025-06-16-02 adopted 6/16/2025 (on Â§ 30.03.002 and Â§ 30.03.023); the text is in force, not a retired scheme. Table: 22 districts. Deliberate refusals: C-1/C-2/C-3 each state FOUR setback combinations (footprint tier x residential/nonresidential abutting use) and only the smallest-footprint, nonresidential-abutting column is codified, with the other three quoted verbatim in the same field's provenance under an explicit TIERED SETBACKS caveat in the note; C-4 states only a perimeter setback (100 ft. abutting residential / 40 ft. abutting nonresidential) and no front/side/rear split at all, so its yards are coded 999/not_specified rather than forcing the perimeter figure into a yard slot; M states its entire block as 'Subject to approval of city council'; P-1 and P-2 carry no setback subsection; MMC's height is not stated in the dimensional subsections read, so it is coded 999 rather than borrowed. Conditional exceptions are preserved, not dropped: the recurring '(golf course 25)' parenthetical, R-2's '(10' if adjacent to external residential)', R-8's '(25 ft. if abutting R-4..R-7)' and the '10*' footnotes in HM/GUI/AV/REC all appear verbatim in the affected fields' provenance while the base value is codified. PUD (Â§ 30.03.021, negotiated), VPCO (Â§ 30.03.023, overlay) and GB (Â§ 30.03.020, no dimensional block) are omitted with the reason in the note. Lot coverage and impervious cover are 999/not_specified wherever the source says 'See development ordinance' / 'See watershed development ordinance', because the deferred document (art. 28.10) was not read. All values primary-source-verified; no code-section atom corpus exists for this jurisdiction. openThreads.thread: The state vocabulary has no token for 'instrument located and reachable, extraction not attempted'. Eight cities (mustang-ridge-tx, bee-cave-tx, west-lake-hills-tx, briarcliff-tx, point-venture-tx, the-hills-tx, san-leanna-tx, creedmoor-tx â€” 9,811 parcels) are in exactly that position and are recorded as blocked with blocked_without_wall: true.
openThreads.why: The brief says to use blocked 'only where a real instrument appears to exist but you were prevented from reaching it (a token wall, a bot wall, a dead layer)'. For these eight nothing prevented the read. The alternative tokens are worse: declared-unacquirable would be false (they ARE acquirable, and one is a single public PDF fetch), and acquired would be false. Recommendation: add a token such as acquirable-not-extracted, or allow blocked to carry a wall/no-wall flag so a planner can size the remaining work without reading 20 notes.
